title: Kinds of jobs: parties, serenading, car rides
summary: Party jobs, serenading at porches, playing anywhere for a dollar, being driven around to play, and the three-piece combo.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: To get back to August and Cyun, what kind of jobs did you play with them?
Well, we played party jobs, you know, entertaining. We played a few dances, too.
And how would that work, though, when you mentioned serenading? How does that work?

Well, sometimes we would tip on the porch and start playing. The door would fly open. They'd say, come on in, boys. Come on in. I'm glad you're all here. That's serenading, you know? And we played parties, you know? They'd come and get us. Tell us, well, we'd like to have the four of you tonight. Play.
Would you ever go in a saloon and play for dips?

Well, yeah. We'd go anywhere. We ain't had no special place. Anywhere we could get a dollar, we'd go there and play. I see. Anywhere. Ballroom. Patio. We had guys used to just ride us around. We'd play while they ride and all that kind of stuff.
What would you be riding in?
Well, we'd be riding a big car. We'd be sitting in the back. They'd be sitting in the front. We'd be just playing the music for them. All right. They'd listen.

That's right. I've done that. All right. That Columbus, Tennessee. The guy must have ride me and Johnny Bynum about, oh, must have rid us about 80 or 90 miles just to listen to us play. I was playing the ukulele. Johnny was playing the mandolin that time. And he plays wonderful mandolin. And the guys, you know, they'd just give us $10 a piece and say, don't forget, boys, you're going to get some more. We just want you to play for us. So we're going over here and we want our girlfriend to hear y'all. Take us at that house. We'd play some there for a girl. We'd go to the other house. Then they'd bring us back. We'd play all along the highway. Play for them. All that.
I see. Well, with Cyune, would you walk around?

Yeah. Yeah. Cyune's cast violin. Had on his tux. I had my guitar. At least my ukulele. Frank Wagner had his guitar. Three-piece combination. Violin, guitar, and ukulele. We get a dance, then we go get a bass player. With a high bass player.
